title: Audit Where Hacks Pay: Budgeted Strong-Verifier Audits Against Reward Hacking in GRPO
abstract: arXiv:2610.35716v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains on cheap checks, such as unit tests, that a policy can learn to game, while a stronger check is too expensive to run on every rollout. We study how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO, separating which weakly passing rollouts to audit from what reward a caught hack receives. At a fixed policy state with centered advantages, the expected update depends on a design only through each rollout's marginal audit probability and correction; reflecting a caught hack's reward about the failure reward negates the advantages of an all-hack group; and auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits, LB) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks among pass-count designs with a fixed correction when a label's value falls with the pass count. translated_title: 审计作弊得利之处：以预算受限的强验证器审计对抗GRPO中的奖励作弊
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习依赖廉价的检查手段（如单元测试）进行训练，而策略可能学会钻这些检查的空子，同时更强的检查手段因成本过高而无法对每个 rollout 都运行。我们研究了如何在 GRPO 中分配有限的强验证器预算，将“审计哪些弱通过的 rollout”与“被抓获的作弊行为应获得什么奖励”这两个问题分离开来。在具有中心化优势的固定策略状态下，期望更新仅通过每个 rollout 的边际审计概率与修正量依赖于设计；将被抓获作弊的奖励沿失败奖励进行取反，可以抵消全部由作弊样本组成的组的优势；并且当标签的价值随通过次数下降时，优先审计弱通过次数最少的整组（低通过次数预算审计，LB）在固定修正量的通过次数设计方案中，能最小化残留在作弊样本上的优势质量。我们在实际的 LLM 训练中测试了这一分析：从每次运行的初始状态出发，该优势质量在……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究了如何在GRPO中以有限的强验证器预算对抗奖励作弊，证明优先对弱通过次数最少的样本组进行整体审计（LB策略）能最小化残留在作弊样本上的优势质量。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how to spend a limited strong-verifier budget in GRPO against reward hacking, showing that auditing whole groups with the fewest weak passes first (low-pass budgeted audits) minimizes the advantage mass left on hacks.
